hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'case "{}" in *.env|*.env.*|*service-account*|*service_account*|*credentials*|*secret*) echo "BLOCKED: protected file: {}" >&2; exit 2;; esac'

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE '(git push --force|git reset --hard|rm -rf|DROP TABLE|DELETE FROM.*WHERE|systemctl stop)' && { echo 'BLOCKED: dangerous command detected' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
